explication: eslint-plugin-import is an ESLint plugin for checking JavaScript and TypeScript module imports and exports. ESLint invokes the registered rules on source files; the rules inspect syntax and settings, resolve module paths where needed, and report or autofix violations. Export analysis parses modules into cached maps of exported names and dependencies, enabling checks such as named-export validity, cycles, and unused modules. The README documents broad rule families and legacy/flat configurations; the graph groups those capabilities without enumerating every rule. Unsampled subsystems are represented only where the tree or README supports them; edges cite shown imports or documented product behavior.
